Dialogue.Text: (My first day at the lab,^2 this will be fun!)
(They've specifically asked for someone to join on an unspecified mission.^1 Of course,^2 they'd be sending students to it,^2 but who cares?^1 I'll get snacks!)
Ah,^2 there you are.^1 Do excuse my tardiness,^2 I had a former appointment with the StugA to add more *water coolers* around the University.
I^2 *love*^2 water!^1 And I shall do everything in my might to have them in vicinity all the time.
... right.^1 But what about the job offer you posted.^1 You were searching for someone of my abilities?
That's correct.^1 I see you signed the form of consent already,^2 which means I get to educate you now on the proceedings of your task.
You see,^2 there is this restaurant that we always had a gaze on.^1 *The Orange Kitten*,^2 ever heard of that establishment?
Yes,^2 they make like very tasty food,^2 don't they?^1 What do you want from them?
Well,^2 we'd like to...^2 *borrow*...^2 their recipes so that we may uncover the secrets behind them.^1 Why do they taste so good?^1 That is what we'd like to know.
How do I come into play?
I'm glad you asked,^2 this is something only a student worker could accomplish.^1 Us persons of science are way too busy with discovering new things every day.
Look how cute that kitty is!! I will make it my mission to pet it for the entire day now!
Anyways,^2 let us proceed to my office.
